entries: Improved streaming of agent replies: lines that scroll off the top of the screen are now scrolled into your terminal's scrollback instead of repainting the whole screen, and text wrapping writes whole runs of text at a time, so streaming writes about 70% fewer bytes to the terminal and stays much smoother over slow SSH connections.

Improved memory use shortly after startup: the CLI now returns about 100 MB of memory left over from startup to the operating system 15 seconds after the interactive UI opens; print and headless modes are unaffected.

Improved the after-compaction size shown in the compaction marker and in `/context` to also count what the summary carries into the next prompt, such as your earlier requests and artifact, subagent, and running-task snapshots, so it is closer to the real size; the `(N summary)` label still shows the summary alone.

Fixed subagents losing the task their parent agent gave them, and the parent's ID, after their context was compacted, including with `/compact`; a subagent's summary now keeps the parent agent's 10 most recent messages.

Fixed conversations with many or large images, such as screenshots or pasted images, being rejected for exceeding the model's request size limit: images are now capped at 2000 pixels per side and large PNGs are sent as JPEGs when that is much smaller, and an image saved as JPEG but labeled PNG, such as a pasted image or browser screenshot, is no longer rejected for a mismatched type.

Fixed the `/browser` subagent not receiving the current page's snapshot when the selected page belongs to an isolated browser context, such as a page opened with `isolatedContext` or attached from an Incognito window.

Added image pasting through your terminal's own paste shortcut, such as `Cmd+V` or `Ctrl+Shift+V` with only an image copied, and by dragging image files into the prompt, which attaches them instead of inserting their paths; image paste now also works over SSH with X11 or Wayland forwarding, and the CLI's paste key now says `No image or video found in the clipboard` when there is nothing to attach and names the clipboard tool to install, such as `wl-clipboard` on Wayland, when one is missing.

Improved the `/plugin` Discover tab to group marketplace plugins into the same sections as the Antigravity plugin marketplace instead of one flat list, listing a plugin under every section it belongs to.

Improved `agy plugin validate` to warn when a plugin's `name` isn't lowercase kebab-case, such as `Neo4j` or `foo_bar`, which the marketplace can't publish, and to suggest a valid name, failing under `--strict`; it now also checks the plugin's `logo`, noting when `plugin.json` has none and warning when the logo path is blank, uses backslashes, is absolute or points outside the plugin, sits in a folder the marketplace bundle leaves out such as `.github/`, or is a URL that won't be shown, with the same checks for context provider `iconUri` values.

Improved the position indicator under long `/diff` lists to say what it counts, such as `[1-44 of 195 files]` in `All Changes` and `[1-44 of 195 rows]` in `Per Turn`, where turn headers count as rows, so it no longer appears to disagree with the file count.

Improved Auto mode's review of commands that would leave the terminal sandbox: the reviewer now knows whether the working directory is inside a Git or other repository, so it no longer spends its time budget running `git status` in folders that aren't repositories and times out less often.

Changed `execute_url` permissions so approving a Google site such as `www.google.com` or `cloud.google.com` no longer also allows sensitive Google apps such as `mail.google.com`, `docs.google.com`, `drive.google.com`, `accounts.google.com`, or `console.cloud.google.com`; each of these now needs its own approval.

Fixed always-allow rules for multi-line commands, such as a `python -c` or `node -e` script spanning several lines, never taking effect, which made the CLI ask again every time and pile up unusable entries in your settings; existing multi-line rules now apply.

Fixed onboarding screens being cut off in small terminals and hiding their buttons: text and links now wrap to the terminal width, the color preview is cropped or hidden in very narrow terminals, the banner only shows when the whole step fits, and a step that is still too tall scrolls with `Shift+↑`/`Shift+↓` or `PgUp`/`PgDn` while the buttons stay visible.

Fixed Vim mode's `r`, `f`, `F`, `t`, and `T` canceling when the target character is a space, so `r<space>`, `f<space>`, and `df<space>` now work, commands on an empty last line acting on the line above, and a half-typed operator such as `d` carrying over after you submit a prompt.
Fixed invisible U+FFF9 and U+FFFA characters reaching the terminal around wrapped code in agent replies, which made some terminals and multiplexers draw boxes or leave stale characters on screen.

Fixed conversations failing every later model request with `INVALID_MEDIA` after the agent viewed a corrupt image or one with text in front of its header, such as a screenshot captured with `adb exec-out screencap -p > screenshot.png` that also captured a warning; such images are now rejected with an error that says where the real image header starts, so the agent can fix the command.

Fixed conversations getting stuck failing on every turn after a tool result was left without its matching tool call, such as after older history was trimmed; unmatched tool calls and results are now left out of the request.

Fixed conversations with certain models on a Google Cloud project failing for the rest of the conversation once the system prompt, tools, or an earlier message changed after a thinking block; outdated thinking blocks are now dropped instead of rejected.

Fixed the `/browser` subagent not receiving the current page's snapshot at the start of each turn with Chrome DevTools MCP 1.11 and later, because the snapshot request left out the now-required page ID and failed silently.

title.zh-TW: 支援終端機快捷鍵與拖曳貼圖，SSH 遠端連線也能直接傳圖
title.en: Terminal Paste Shortcuts and Image Dragging Support, Even over Remote SSH Connections

body.zh-TW: 當你想讓 AI 幫忙分析螢幕截圖或設計稿時，不再需要手動輸入檔案的完整路徑。⟦跟在通訊軟體聊天室傳照片一樣，以前把圖拖進終端機只會留下一串檔案路徑，現在能直接把圖片塞進對話，遠端連線時也能精準送達。⟧只要剪貼簿裡只有圖片，按下終端機自身的貼上快速鍵（如 Mac 上的 `Cmd+V` 或其他系統的 `Ctrl+Shift+V`），就能直接貼上圖片。直接把圖片檔案拖曳到輸入框時，終端機會把檔案當成附件加入，不再只是填入檔案路徑。即使透過 SSH 連線並啟用 X11 或 Wayland 轉發顯示，貼圖操作也能照常運作。當剪貼簿沒有可附加的媒體時，按下貼上鍵會看到 `No image or video found in the clipboard` 提示。若環境缺少剪貼工具，提示更會明確指名該安裝的套件名稱，例如 Wayland 上的 `wl-clipboard`。
body.en: When you want the AI to analyze screenshots or design drafts, you no longer need to manually enter full file paths. ⟦Just as you share photos in a messaging chat, where dragging an image into the terminal used to leave only a file path, you can now insert images directly into the conversation, even reaching remote connections accurately.⟧ As long as only an image is in the clipboard, pressing your terminal's own paste shortcut (such as `Cmd+V` on Mac or `Ctrl+Shift+V` on other systems) pastes the image directly. Dragging image files straight into the prompt attaches them as files instead of inserting their paths. Image pasting operates normally even over SSH connections with X11 or Wayland forwarding enabled. When the clipboard contains no attachable media, pressing paste displays a `No image or video found in the clipboard` message. If the environment lacks a clipboard utility, the notice explicitly names the package to install, such as `wl-clipboard` on Wayland.

items.original: Added image pasting through your terminal's own paste shortcut, such as `Cmd+V` or `Ctrl+Shift+V` with only an image copied, and by dragging image files into the prompt, which attaches them instead of inserting their paths; image paste now also works over SSH with X11 or Wayland forwarding, and the CLI's paste key now says `No image or video found in the clipboard` when there is nothing to attach and names the clipboard tool to install, such as `wl-clipboard` on Wayland, when one is missing.

title.zh-TW: 外掛探索頁依市集分區歸類，發布驗證新增名稱與圖示檢查
title.en: Plugin Discover Tab Groups by Marketplace Sections, with New Name and Logo Checks for Validation

body.zh-TW: 想要替終端機尋找擴充功能，或是準備發布自己編寫的外掛，現在能直接對齊官方市集的標準。⟦如同逛百貨商場，以前所有商品全塞在同一份冗長名單，現在依專區分類陳列，同時對準備進駐的專櫃嚴格核對招牌與名稱格式。⟧在終端機輸入 `/plugin` 切換到 Discover 探索分頁，外掛不再是一整串清單，而是依官方市集分區歸類，跨領域外掛也會出現在所有相關分區。使用 `agy plugin validate` 檢驗外掛時，若名稱未用全小寫 kebab-case（例如 `Neo4j`），工具會提出警告並建議合規名稱，搭配 `--strict` 則中斷失敗。檢驗也納入了圖示檢查，若未設定 `logo`、路徑指向外部或打包排除的 `.github/`、或填寫外部網址皆會警告，同樣適用於情境提供者的 `iconUri`。
body.en: Whether looking for terminal extensions or preparing to publish your own plugin, you can now align directly with official marketplace standards. ⟦Picture browsing a department store where every product was once lumped into a single sprawling roster; items are now arranged across dedicated sections, while incoming storefronts have their signboards and name formats strictly checked.⟧ Entering `/plugin` in the terminal to open the Discover tab presents plugins grouped by official marketplace sections rather than one flat list, with cross-category plugins listed under every relevant section. When testing plugins with `agy plugin validate`, names not using lowercase kebab-case (such as `Neo4j`) trigger a warning with suggested valid alternatives, failing under `--strict`. Validation now checks logos as well, warning if `logo` is unset, points externally or into bundled-out folders like `.github/`, or specifies external URLs, with the same checks applied to context provider `iconUri` values.

items.original:
Improved the `/plugin` Discover tab to group marketplace plugins into the same sections as the Antigravity plugin marketplace instead of one flat list, listing a plugin under every section it belongs to.
Improved `agy plugin validate` to warn when a plugin's `name` isn't lowercase kebab-case, such as `Neo4j` or `foo_bar`, which the marketplace can't publish, and to suggest a valid name, failing under `--strict`; it now also checks the plugin's `logo`, noting when `plugin.json` has none and warning when the logo path is blank, uses backslashes, is absolute or points outside the plugin, sits in a folder the marketplace bundle leaves out such as `.github/`, or is a URL that won't be shown, with the same checks for context provider `iconUri` values.

title.zh-TW: 長 diff 清單清楚標記統計單位，區分檔案總數與輪次列數
title.en: Long Diff Lists Explicitly Label Count Units, Distinguishing File Totals from Turn Rows

body.zh-TW: 當你在終端機翻閱大量程式碼變更紀錄時，清單底部的導覽數字能清楚看出計算標準。⟦就像翻閱裝訂合冊，以前底部的頁碼沒有說明單位，章節標題和正文混著算，讓人誤以為缺頁；現在明確標出是總篇數還是包含標題的排版行數。⟧在長度較長的 `/diff` 變更清單下方，位置指示器過去只顯示數字範圍，容易讓人疑惑目前指涉的究竟是檔案還是畫面行數。現在指示器會依據檢視模式明確標記統計單位，在檢視全部變更的 `All Changes` 模式下會顯示如 `[1-44 of 195 files]`，清楚標示為檔案數量。若切換到依對話輪次呈現的 `Per Turn` 模式，由於輪次標題也會計入列數，介面便會顯示如 `[1-44 of 195 rows]`。這樣的區分讓指示器不再與實際的檔案計數產生矛盾。
body.en: When browsing through extensive code change records in the terminal, navigation numbers at the bottom of the list clearly display their counting standard. ⟦Think of leafing through a bound anthology where footer numbers previously omitted units and mixed chapter headers with text, making readers suspect missing pages; it now specifies whether it tallies total articles or formatted layout rows including headers.⟧ Under longer `/diff` change lists, the position indicator previously showed only numeric ranges, leaving it ambiguous whether it referenced files or screen lines. The indicator now explicitly labels counting units according to the view mode, displaying counts like `[1-44 of 195 files]` in `All Changes` mode to clearly denote file totals. Switching to `Per Turn` mode displays `[1-44 of 195 rows]`, since turn headers also count toward row totals. This distinction ensures the indicator no longer conflicts with actual file counts.

items.original: Improved the position indicator under long `/diff` lists to say what it counts, such as `[1-44 of 195 files]` in `All Changes` and `[1-44 of 195 rows]` in `Per Turn`, where turn headers count as rows, so it no longer appears to disagree with the file count.

title.zh-TW: 自動模式審查指令跳過無效檢查，非儲存庫目錄不再逾時
title.en: Auto Mode Command Review Skips Irrelevant Checks, Eliminating Timeouts in Non-Repository Folders

body.zh-TW: 使用自動模式（Auto mode）讓 AI 執行可能離開終端機沙盒的指令時，審查流程不再無端卡在逾時中斷。⟦好比社區保全巡檢，以前每到一個空房間都要翻找不存在的訪客登記簿，耗盡巡邏時間；現在先確認門牌是否有管委會編制，沒有就不再白花力氣翻查。⟧當審查機制評估指令是否會脫離終端機沙盒時，現在會先掌握目前工作目錄是否隸屬於 Git 或其他版本控制儲存庫。過去審查機制會在所有目錄盲目分配時間預算執行 `git status`，在一般資料夾中頻繁引發逾時。現在排除了非儲存庫目錄的無謂執行，指令審查過程中的逾時發生率明顯降低。
body.en: When using Auto mode to let the AI execute commands that might leave the terminal sandbox, the review process no longer stalls on unexpected timeouts. ⟦A security guard doing neighborhood rounds used to rifle through nonexistent visitor logs in every empty room, running out the patrol clock; now they verify whether the unit is registered with the property board before searching.⟧ When evaluating whether a command leaves the terminal sandbox, the reviewer now first determines whether the working directory belongs to a Git or other version control repository. Previously, the reviewer spent its time budget running `git status` blindly across all folders, triggering frequent timeouts in regular directories. By bypassing unneeded runs in non-repository folders, timeout rates during command reviews are noticeably reduced.

items.original: Improved Auto mode's review of commands that would leave the terminal sandbox: the reviewer now knows whether the working directory is inside a Git or other repository, so it no longer spends its time budget running `git status` in folders that aren't repositories and times out less often.

title.zh-TW: execute_url 權限劃分隔離，存取 Google 敏感服務需個別授權
title.en: execute_url Permissions Isolated to Require Separate Approvals for Sensitive Google Services

body.zh-TW: 允許 AI 工具存取公開網頁時，私密帳號與雲端主控台不會再被自動放行。⟦宛如訪客換證，以前只要拿到大樓公共大廳的通行證，就能一路刷進私人辦公室與保險庫；現在大廳門票與機要庫房嚴格分開，每間獨立套房都得重新核對許可。⟧在使用 `execute_url` 呼叫網址時，權限規則縮小了授權的繼承範圍。過去一旦批准了 `www.google.com` 或 `cloud.google.com` 這類 Google 站點，工具便會連帶放行同網域下的敏感應用程式。現在包含 `mail.google.com`、`docs.google.com`、`drive.google.com`、`accounts.google.com` 以及 `console.cloud.google.com` 等服務皆已獨立列管。其中的每一項敏感服務都必須由你個別審批授權，不再自動繼承一般網站的存取權限。
body.en: When permitting AI tools to access public web pages, private accounts and cloud consoles are no longer automatically approved alongside them. ⟦Consider visitor badges at an office building where an entry pass to the public lobby previously granted access all the way into private offices and vaults; general lobby admission is now strictly separated from secure vaults, requiring every suite to verify clearance individually.⟧ When invoking web addresses with `execute_url`, permission rules now restrict the inherited scope of authorizations. Previously, approving a Google site like `www.google.com` or `cloud.google.com` also granted access to sensitive apps under the same domain. Services including `mail.google.com`, `docs.google.com`, `drive.google.com`, `accounts.google.com`, and `console.cloud.google.com` are now isolated under separate management. Each sensitive service requires your explicit individual approval rather than inheriting general website access.

items.original: Changed `execute_url` permissions so approving a Google site such as `www.google.com` or `cloud.google.com` no longer also allows sensitive Google apps such as `mail.google.com`, `docs.google.com`, `drive.google.com`, `accounts.google.com`, or `console.cloud.google.com`; each of these now needs its own approval.

title.zh-TW: 多行指令一律允許規則正式生效，不再重複詢問或堆積無效設定
title.en: Always-Allow Rules for Multi-Line Commands Now Take Effect, Preventing Repeated Prompts and Unusable Settings

body.zh-TW: 在終端機執行跨好幾行的 `python -c` 或 `node -e` 腳本時，即便早就勾選過一律放行，命令列以前每次執行依然停下來要你確認，設定檔裡也塞滿了無法使用的項目。現在這個問題已經修好，先前儲存的多行規則已能正常套用，執行時不再重複跳出確認提示。
body.en: When running multi-line `python -c` or `node -e` scripts in the terminal, even if you had chosen to always allow them, the command line previously paused for confirmation on every execution while accumulating unusable entries in your settings. This issue is now resolved, and previously saved multi-line rules apply properly without repeatedly prompting for confirmation.

items.original: Fixed always-allow rules for multi-line commands, such as a `python -c` or `node -e` script spanning several lines, never taking effect, which made the CLI ask again every time and pile up unusable entries in your settings; existing multi-line rules now apply.

title.zh-TW: 新手導覽頁面自適應小型視窗，按鈕保持可見並支援上下捲動
title.en: Onboarding Screens Adapt to Small Terminals, Keeping Buttons Visible and Enabling Scrolling

body.zh-TW: 初次啟動工具並在較小尺寸的終端機視窗查看新手導覽時，以前畫面常被視窗邊界硬生生切斷，導致底部的確認按鈕被隱藏而無法點擊。現在文字與連結會自動配合視窗寬度折行。在極窄的終端機中，色彩預覽會自動裁切或隱藏，橫幅標語也只在畫面能完整容納時才會顯示。若步驟內容依然過長，你可以使用 `Shift+↑`、`Shift+↓` 或 `PgUp`、`PgDn` 進行上下捲動，而操作按鈕則全程保持可見。
body.en: When launching the tool for the first time and viewing onboarding screens in a smaller terminal window, the display was often cut off by window boundaries, hiding bottom confirmation buttons from view. Text and links now wrap automatically to fit terminal width. In very narrow terminals, the color preview is automatically cropped or hidden, and the banner only displays when the screen can accommodate it entirely. If step content is still too tall, you can scroll up and down using `Shift+↑`, `Shift+↓`, `PgUp`, or `PgDn`, while action buttons stay visible throughout.

items.original: Fixed onboarding screens being cut off in small terminals and hiding their buttons: text and links now wrap to the terminal width, the color preview is cropped or hidden in very narrow terminals, the banner only shows when the whole step fits, and a step that is still too tall scrolls with `Shift+↑`/`Shift+↓` or `PgUp`/`PgDn` while the buttons stay visible.

title.zh-TW: Vim 模式支援空白鍵定位，修正游標誤判與未完成指令殘留
title.en: Vim Mode Supports Space Targets, Fixing Cursor Misalignment and Lingering Incomplete Commands

body.zh-TW: 在終端機開啟 Vim 編輯模式時，以前按下 `r`、`f`、`F`、`t` 與 `T` 等指令若接續空白鍵，操作會被直接取消。現在 `r<space>`、`f<space>` 與 `df<space>` 等組合皆能正常運作。游標停在最後一行空白列時，指令不再誤套用到上一行。送出提示詞後，未輸入完畢的運算子（如單獨按下的 `d`）也不會再殘留至下一輪對話。
body.en: When using Vim editing mode in the terminal, pressing commands like `r`, `f`, `F`, `t`, and `T` followed by a space previously canceled the action. Combinations such as `r<space>`, `f<space>`, and `df<space>` now work properly. With the cursor on an empty last line, commands no longer mistakenly apply to the line above. After submitting a prompt, half-typed operators (such as a solitary `d`) no longer carry over into the next conversation turn.

items.original: Fixed Vim mode's `r`, `f`, `F`, `t`, and `T` canceling when the target character is a space, so `r<space>`, `f<space>`, and `df<space>` now work, commands on an empty last line acting on the line above, and a half-typed operator such as `d` carrying over after you submit a prompt.

title.zh-TW: 修正折行程式碼周圍的隱藏字元，終端機畫面不再出現方框與殘留字元
title.en: Hidden Characters Stripped Around Wrapped Code, Eliminating Boxes and Stale Artifacts in Terminals

body.zh-TW: 當 AI 回覆包含折行程式碼時，以前不可見的特殊字元（U+FFF9 與 U+FFFA）會意外流進終端機，導致部分終端機或終端多工器將其繪製成異常方框，或在螢幕上留下殘留字元。這個問題現在已經修好，畫面上不再出現多餘方塊或殘留字元。
body.en: When agent replies included wrapped code, invisible special characters (U+FFF9 and U+FFFA) previously leaked into the terminal, causing some terminals or terminal multiplexers to render them as unexpected boxes or leave stale characters on screen. This issue has now been resolved, and superfluous boxes or leftover characters no longer appear on screen.

items.original: Fixed invisible U+FFF9 and U+FFFA characters reaching the terminal around wrapped code in agent replies, which made some terminals and multiplexers draw boxes or leave stale characters on screen.

title.zh-TW: 修復對話持續報錯問題，排除異常圖片、工具失配與過期思考區塊
title.en: Persistent Conversation Errors Resolved by Omitting Malformed Images, Mismatched Tools, and Outdated Thinking Blocks

body.zh-TW:
當對話歷程中出現異常的圖檔、工具結果或思考區塊時，過去幾種會導致後續對話全面卡死的情況已獲得修復。

如果 AI 讀取到損毀圖片，或標頭前方夾雜文字（例如使用 `adb exec-out screencap -p > screenshot.png` 截圖混入警告），過去會持續遭遇 `INVALID_MEDIA` 錯誤。現在這類圖片會被直接拒絕，並指出真實標頭起始位置，讓 AI 自行修正指令。

當歷史紀錄遭裁切導致工具結果失去對應呼叫時，過去每輪對話都會卡死報錯。現在送出請求時會主動排除未配對的工具呼叫與結果。

在 Google Cloud 專案使用特定模型時，若思考區塊（thinking block）出現後系統提示、工具或先前訊息變更，對話過去會持續失敗。現在過期的思考區塊會直接捨棄而不再拒絕請求。
body.en:
Several failure modes that previously caused subsequent turns to freeze when anomalous images, tool results, or thinking blocks appeared in conversation history have now been resolved.

If the AI read a corrupt image or one with text preceding its header (such as a screenshot captured with `adb exec-out screencap -p > screenshot.png` that mixed in warnings), conversations repeatedly ran into `INVALID_MEDIA` errors. Such images are now rejected directly with an error indicating where the real header starts, allowing the AI to fix the command.

When trimmed history left a tool result without its matching call, conversations previously froze with errors on every turn. Sending requests now actively omits unmatched tool calls and results.

When using certain models on a Google Cloud project, if the system prompt, tools, or an earlier message changed after a thinking block, conversations previously failed persistently. Outdated thinking blocks are now dropped rather than rejecting the request.

items.original:
Fixed conversations failing every later model request with `INVALID_MEDIA` after the agent viewed a corrupt image or one with text in front of its header, such as a screenshot captured with `adb exec-out screencap -p > screenshot.png` that also captured a warning; such images are now rejected with an error that says where the real image header starts, so the agent can fix the command.
Fixed conversations getting stuck failing on every turn after a tool result was left without its matching tool call, such as after older history was trimmed; unmatched tool calls and results are now left out of the request.
Fixed conversations with certain models on a Google Cloud project failing for the rest of the conversation once the system prompt, tools, or an earlier message changed after a thinking block; outdated thinking blocks are now dropped instead of rejected.

title.zh-TW: 修復瀏覽器子代理無快照問題，補上 DevTools MCP 必要頁面編號
title.en: Fix Browser Subagent Missing Snapshots by Adding Required DevTools MCP Page ID

body.zh-TW: 在搭配 Chrome DevTools MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）1.11 或更新版本時，以前 `/browser` 子代理在每輪對話開始時會無法取得當前網頁的快照畫面。這是因為請求中遺漏了新版所必需的頁面識別碼（page ID），導致快照擷取在背後默默失敗。現在這個問題已經修好，請求已補上必要的頁面編號，子代理在每輪開始時皆能順利讀取網頁快照。
body.en: When used with Chrome DevTools MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that connects AI to external tools) 1.11 or later, the `/browser` subagent previously failed to obtain snapshots of the current page at the start of each turn. This happened because the request omitted the page ID required by the new version, causing snapshot capture to fail silently in the background. This issue has now been resolved, with the required page ID added to the request so that the subagent can smoothly retrieve webpage snapshots at the start of each turn.

items.original: Fixed the `/browser` subagent not receiving the current page's snapshot at the start of each turn with Chrome DevTools MCP 1.11 and later, because the snapshot request left out the now-required page ID and failed silently.

entries: Added `[` and `]` to the `Per Turn` tab in `/diff` to jump to the first file of the previous or next turn, wrapping around at either end, in both the file list and the file view; the `All Changes` and `Per Turn` key-hint footers now wrap onto a second row on narrow terminals instead of being cut off.

Improved how quickly `/diff` opens in large repositories and long conversations: `All Changes` and `Commit Tree` appear as soon as tracked changes are ready, showing `checking for untracked files…` while untracked files load in the background, and `Per Turn` shows the newest turns first and loads older ones in the background with a `checking N older turn(s)…` indicator, caching finished turns so reopening `/diff` only recomputes the latest one.

Improved `/diff` in checkouts with large untracked files: binary files and untracked files over 1 MB are listed with a note such as `binary file` or `7.3 MB, over the 1 MB limit` instead of being read into memory, untracked files containing lines that start with `++` followed by a space are no longer shown incorrectly, and a file deleted while `/diff` is loading no longer makes the whole file list fail.

Improved Auto mode's review of commands that would leave the terminal sandbox: it now has more time to decide and stops any single slow check after 10 seconds, so it times out less often and asks you to approve safe commands less often.

Improved `agy plugin install` output to name each installed skill, agent, rule, command, MCP server, and hook, to stop listing component types the plugin doesn't contain as skipped, and to print the folder the plugin was installed to, adding `(replaced existing installation)` when it overwrote an earlier copy.

Improved `agy plugin validate` to check the `author`, `homepage`, and `repository` fields in `plugin.json`, warning when `author` is neither a name string nor a `{"name", "url"}` object or when a URL isn't a valid `https://` link, and plugin listings now show the author's name when `author` is written as an object instead of leaving it blank.
Improved resuming a conversation to use about 10% less CPU by not rendering already finished tool calls a second time.

Fixed failed tool calls, including calls to a tool that doesn't exist and canceled or interrupted calls, being passed back to the agent as ordinary results; the agent now sees them as errors and can recover on its next step.

Fixed conversations forked from one with an active `/goal`, including `/btw` side questions and forked subagents, inheriting that goal and being unable to stop; the inherited goal is now canceled at the fork point.
Fixed subagents failing to run when their custom agent's `name` contains a colon.
Fixed deleting a conversation leaving its running subagents, their saved history, and their shared or branched workspaces behind; they are now stopped and cleaned up with it.
Fixed a memory leak in long sessions with plugins that run sidecars, where every sidecar run left a background task running for the rest of the session.

Fixed pasting images on Windows when they were copied from a browser, Snipping Tool, or another app that puts PNG or V5 bitmap data on the clipboard, and pasting now retries when another app briefly holds the clipboard.

title.zh-TW: /diff 支援按鍵跨輪次跳轉，大專案變更即時開啟並在背景載入
title.en: /diff supports key-based turn jumping, opening large repository changes instantly with background loading

body.zh-TW: 當你在大型專案或多輪對話中打開 `/diff` 查看變更時，介面不再需要等全部檔案掃描完才顯示。⟦就像餐廳出餐，招牌熱菜先上桌讓客人享用，慢燉的湯品則在後廚繼續準備，不必整桌乾等。⟧現在已追蹤變更與 `Commit Tree` 會立即出現，未追蹤檔案改在背景載入；`Per Turn` 則先顯示最新輪次並快取（把算過的結果暫存起來直接用），舊輪次於背景載入。在 `Per Turn` 中可按 `[` 與 `]` 循環跳至相鄰輪次首個檔案，狹窄終端機的按鍵提示也會折成兩列。超過 1 MB 與二進位檔案改以附註標記而不載入記憶體，未追蹤檔案中以 `++` 加空格開頭的行，也不再被錯誤顯示，載入中途刪除檔案也不再讓清單失敗。
body.en: When you open `/diff` to inspect changes in large repositories or long conversations, the interface no longer waits for all files to finish scanning before displaying. ⟦Just like restaurant service where signature hot dishes are brought out immediately for diners while slow-simmered soups keep cooking in the kitchen, nobody has to wait idly for the entire meal.⟧ Tracked changes and `Commit Tree` now appear immediately while untracked files load in the background, and `Per Turn` displays the newest turns first and caches them while older turns load in the background. In `Per Turn`, you can press `[` and `]` to jump cyclically to the first file of adjacent turns, and key hints now wrap onto two rows on narrow terminals. Files over 1 MB and binary files are noted instead of being read into memory, lines starting with `++` followed by a space in untracked files are no longer displayed incorrectly, and deleting a file mid-load no longer causes the entire list to fail.

items.original:
Added `[` and `]` to the `Per Turn` tab in `/diff` to jump to the first file of the previous or next turn, wrapping around at either end, in both the file list and the file view; the `All Changes` and `Per Turn` key-hint footers now wrap onto a second row on narrow terminals instead of being cut off.
Improved how quickly `/diff` opens in large repositories and long conversations: `All Changes` and `Commit Tree` appear as soon as tracked changes are ready, showing `checking for untracked files…` while untracked files load in the background, and `Per Turn` shows the newest turns first and loads older ones in the background with a `checking N older turn(s)…` indicator, caching finished turns so reopening `/diff` only recomputes the latest one.
Improved `/diff` in checkouts with large untracked files: binary files and untracked files over 1 MB are listed with a note such as `binary file` or `7.3 MB, over the 1 MB limit` instead of being read into memory, untracked files containing lines that start with `++` followed by a space are no longer shown incorrectly, and a file deleted while `/diff` is loading no longer makes the whole file list fail.

title.zh-TW: Auto 模式沙盒指令審查放寬至 10 秒，減少安全指令手動確認
title.en: Auto mode sandbox command review extended to 10 seconds, reducing manual approvals for safe commands

body.zh-TW: 如果你平時習慣開啟 Auto 模式讓代理自動執行指令，遇到需要跳出終端機沙盒的操作時常會被打斷。⟦跟高速公路的電子收費車道一樣，感應系統有多一點時間辨識車牌，十秒內確認正常就直接抬桿，不再動輒把駕駛轉去人工收費亭。⟧例如當你請代理下載專案依賴或檢查遠端環境時，審查機制現在有更充裕的時間做出判定。只要單一緩慢檢查達到 10 秒就會及時停止，避免無謂等待。這有效降低了審查逾時的機率，遇到安全無虞的指令時，介面不再動不動就跳出手動確認詢問你。
body.en: If you regularly use Auto mode to let the agent run commands automatically, operations that need to leave the terminal sandbox often interrupt you. ⟦Much like an electronic highway toll lane where sensors get extra time to read license plates and lift the gate directly once verified normal within ten seconds, drivers are no longer routinely diverted to manual toll booths.⟧ For example, when you ask the agent to download project dependencies or inspect remote environments, the review mechanism now has more time to decide. Any single slow check stops promptly after reaching 10 seconds to avoid unnecessary waiting. This effectively reduces the chance of review timeouts, so the interface no longer constantly prompts you for manual approval on safe commands.

items.original: Improved Auto mode's review of commands that would leave the terminal sandbox: it now has more time to decide and stops any single slow check after 10 seconds, so it times out less often and asks you to approve safe commands less often.

title.zh-TW: 外掛安裝輸出與格式驗證改進，並修復邊車常駐程序記憶體洩漏
title.en: Plugin installation output and format validation improved, with sidecar memory leak fixed

body.zh-TW: 管理或開發擴充外掛時，更詳細的終端機回饋能讓你迅速掌握安裝與驗證狀態。執行 `agy plugin install` 會明確列出安裝的技能、代理、規則、指令與掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）。清單也會列出安裝的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，不再把未包含的元件型別列為略過，並印出安裝資料夾與覆寫提示。`agy plugin validate` 會檢查 `plugin.json` 的 `author`、`homepage` 與 `repository`，若網址非 `https://` 或格式不合便提出警告，物件格式的作者名也能在清單正常顯示。以前在長時間工作階段執行邊車（sidecar）外掛會殘留背景任務導致記憶體外洩，這個問題也已修好。
body.en: When managing or developing extensions, more detailed terminal feedback helps you quickly grasp installation and validation status. Running `agy plugin install` now explicitly names installed skills, agents, rules, commands, and hooks (small programs triggered by specific events). The list also names installed MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol connecting AI to external tools) servers, stops listing unincluded component types as skipped, and prints the installation folder along with an overwrite notice. `agy plugin validate` now checks the `author`, `homepage`, and `repository` fields in `plugin.json`, warning if a URL is not `https://` or has an invalid format, while author names in object format now display properly in plugin listings. Previously, running sidecar plugins during long sessions left behind background tasks that led to memory leaks, which has now been fixed.

items.original:
Improved `agy plugin install` output to name each installed skill, agent, rule, command, MCP server, and hook, to stop listing component types the plugin doesn't contain as skipped, and to print the folder the plugin was installed to, adding `(replaced existing installation)` when it overwrote an earlier copy.
Improved `agy plugin validate` to check the `author`, `homepage`, and `repository` fields in `plugin.json`, warning when `author` is neither a name string nor a `{"name", "url"}` object or when a URL isn't a valid `https://` link, and plugin listings now show the author's name when `author` is written as an object instead of leaving it blank.
Fixed a memory leak in long sessions with plugins that run sidecars, where every sidecar run left a background task running for the rest of the session.

title.zh-TW: 對話與子代理生命週期修復，恢復對話降低 10% 處理器負擔
title.en: Conversation and subagent lifecycles fixed, with resuming reducing CPU load by 10%

body.zh-TW: 當你接續先前的對話紀錄、或從現有討論中分岔出額外任務時，往往涉及多個背景處理程序。⟦如同施工工班的調度日誌，接續進度時不重複念出已完工的項目，分派支援小組時切斷總工程的死線牽制，撤場時則徹底拆除臨時搭建的工寮。⟧現在恢復對話時不再重複渲染已經完成的工具呼叫，可省下約 10% 的處理器運算資源。從帶有 `/goal` 目標的對話分岔出新討論、`/btw` 旁支提問或衍生子代理時，繼承的目標會在分岔點自動取消，避免新工作階段停不下來。同時，自訂代理的名稱若含有冒號，過去導致子代理無法啟動的錯誤已獲修正。而當你刪除對話時，執行中的子代理、已存歷史紀錄與共享或分支工作區都會一併停止並清除。
body.en: When you resume an earlier conversation history or fork additional tasks from an existing discussion, multiple background processes are often involved. ⟦A construction crew dispatch log works the same way: resuming progress avoids reading off already finished items, dispatching a support squad cuts ties to the master project's deadline, and clearing the site thoroughly dismantles temporary work sheds.⟧ Resuming a conversation now avoids rendering already finished tool calls a second time, saving about 10% in CPU computing resources. When forking a new discussion, `/btw` side question, or subagent from a conversation with an active `/goal`, the inherited goal is automatically canceled at the fork point, preventing the new session from being unable to stop. Meanwhile, an issue where custom agent names containing a colon prevented subagents from starting has been fixed. When you delete a conversation, running subagents, saved histories, and shared or branched workspaces are now stopped and cleaned up together.

items.original:
Improved resuming a conversation to use about 10% less CPU by not rendering already finished tool calls a second time.
Fixed conversations forked from one with an active `/goal`, including `/btw` side questions and forked subagents, inheriting that goal and being unable to stop; the inherited goal is now canceled at the fork point.
Fixed subagents failing to run when their custom agent's `name` contains a colon.
Fixed deleting a conversation leaving its running subagents, their saved history, and their shared or branched workspaces behind; they are now stopped and cleaned up with it.

title.zh-TW: 工具呼叫失敗明確回傳錯誤狀態，代理能接續自行復原
title.en: Failed tool calls explicitly return error status, enabling agents to self-recover

body.zh-TW: 當代理呼叫外部工具時，執行結果是它決定下一步動作的依據。以前呼叫不存在的工具、或是呼叫被取消與中斷時，這些失敗會被當成一般正常結果傳回給代理，導致它無法察覺異常。現在這類失敗都會被明確視為錯誤回傳，代理能在下一步辨識問題並接續自我復原。
body.en: When an agent calls external tools, execution results serve as the basis for deciding its next move. Previously, calls to nonexistent tools or calls that were canceled or interrupted were passed back to the agent as ordinary normal results, leaving it unaware of any issues. Such failures are now explicitly returned as errors, allowing the agent to recognize the problem on its next step and proceed with self-recovery.

items.original: Fixed failed tool calls, including calls to a tool that doesn't exist and canceled or interrupted calls, being passed back to the agent as ordinary results; the agent now sees them as errors and can recover on its next step.

title.zh-TW: Windows 貼上圖片支援常見格式，剪貼簿被佔用時自動重試
title.en: Image pasting on Windows supports common formats, retrying automatically when clipboard is busy

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 系統中，從其他應用程式複製圖片貼進終端機時常會遇到阻礙。以前如果圖片是從瀏覽器、剪取工具（Snipping Tool）或其他將 PNG 或 V5 點陣圖資料放入剪貼簿的程式複製，貼上動作無法順利讀取。現在這些格式已能正常支援，且當剪貼簿被其他程式短暫佔用時，貼上功能會自動重試。
body.en: In Windows, pasting images copied from other applications into the terminal often ran into obstacles. Previously, if images were copied from a browser, Snipping Tool, or another app that placed PNG or V5 bitmap data on the clipboard, pasting failed to read them properly. These formats are now supported normally, and pasting automatically retries when the clipboard is briefly held by another program.

items.original: Fixed pasting images on Windows when they were copied from a browser, Snipping Tool, or another app that puts PNG or V5 bitmap data on the clipboard, and pasting now retries when another app briefly holds the clipboard.

entries: Added `lastUserInput` to the JSON that hook commands receive on stdin, so a hook can inspect the latest message you sent, for example to screen prompts before the agent acts on them.

Added a temporary opt-in Halloween theme: turn on `Seasonal Themes` in `/config`, a row shown only while the theme is in season, for a Halloween startup banner, a moon-phase spinner, and a themed running light and prompt box borders.
Improved Auto mode to ask for approval less often on routine commands, such as cleaning up temporary files, stopping a local process, or running a code formatter.

Improved headless `-p` runs to use much less CPU, especially for long answers and when you have many saved conversations: they no longer build the conversation search index or render the transcript for display, and no longer start your custom status line and window title commands, none of which print mode shows.
Improved rendering speed while a response streams, when a permission prompt appears, and when you resize the window.
Improved MCP tools that are loaded on demand to return results of up to 10 KB directly to the agent; previously anything over 4 KB was saved to a file that the agent had to read in an extra step.
Improved the `/help` shortcuts tab by leaving out basic navigation keys such as the arrow keys, so the more useful shortcuts are easier to find.
Fixed skills, rules, custom agents, plugins, plugin MCP servers, and hooks not loading when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`).
Fixed conversations compacting over and over when a single message, tool output, or attached document was too large to fit in the context.

Fixed long links that wrap inside a Markdown table cell being linked only on their first line, to a truncated URL, so the whole link can now be clicked or copied. Tables in the default `Terminal` color scheme now use box-drawing borders instead of ASCII `|`, matching the other color schemes.

Fixed copying a long command that wraps across rows in a code block or inline code, which now copies as a single line instead of with a line break at each wrap point; wrapped code-block lines also now break between words and keep the block's indentation.
Fixed Vim mode's `r` replace, in Normal and Visual mode, leaving part of a collapsed `[Pasted text #N]` placeholder behind; the whole placeholder is now replaced.
Fixed plugin and MCP server sign-ins not being saved on macOS and Windows when the token was too large for the system keychain; such tokens are now stored in the CLI's private secrets file.

Fixed plugin MCP servers that sign in with OAuth being able to use a token saved by another user of the same computer account, or keeping the previous user's connection after you switch accounts or sign out. Their tokens now belong to the signed-in user and these servers reconnect when the user changes, so you may need to sign in to them again.

title.zh-TW: 掛鉤指令接收使用者最新輸入，可在代理動作前過濾提示詞
title.en: Hook Commands Receive Latest User Input to Screen Prompts Before Agent Acts

body.zh-TW: 你在編寫自訂安全規範或自動流程時，常希望在 AI 真正開始動手前先確認剛送出的內容。現在傳遞給掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）指令的標準輸入 JSON 資料中，正式加入了 lastUserInput 欄位。⟦郵件收發室的分揀員拿到的清冊上，現在多了一欄最新信件內容，可以在送交專員處理前先檢查這封信。⟧這個欄位記錄了你剛發送的最新訊息。掛鉤可直接讀取 lastUserInput，檢查最新訊息並在代理處理前篩選提示詞。
body.en: When writing custom safety rules or automated workflows, you often want to verify what was just sent before the AI actually begins acting. Now, the lastUserInput field has been officially added to the JSON data that hook (small programs triggered by specific events) commands receive on stdin. ⟦A mailroom sorter now receives a manifest with an extra column showing the latest letter's contents, allowing them to inspect the letter before delivering it to the specialist.⟧ This field records the latest message you just sent. Hooks can directly read lastUserInput to inspect the latest message and screen prompts before the agent acts on them.

items.original: Added `lastUserInput` to the JSON that hook commands receive on stdin, so a hook can inspect the latest message you sent, for example to screen prompts before the agent acts on them.

title.zh-TW: 推出萬聖節限定主題，開機橫幅與月相動畫換上應景外觀
title.en: Halloween Theme Launches for a Limited Time with Seasonal Startup Banner and Moon-Phase Animation

body.zh-TW: 萬聖節主題開放期間，你也能為日常開發環境換上濃厚的節慶氛圍。只要在終端機輸入 /config，就能在設定清單中看見僅在節慶期間出現的 Seasonal Themes 選項。⟦如同街角咖啡館限時換上南瓜燈飾與限定杯套，原本的迎賓招牌與隨行杯身，也暫時換上應景的特殊圖樣。⟧開啟這項功能後，工具啟動時會顯示萬聖節開機橫幅，等待回應時的旋轉指示燈會變換為月相週期動畫，同時還會點綴主題跑馬燈與專屬的提示框邊框。這項外觀純屬季節限定的選用項目，節慶檔期結束後設定選項就會自動隱藏，平時完全不影響簡潔的介面風格。
body.en: While the Halloween theme is active, you can bring a festive atmosphere to your everyday development environment. Just enter /config in the terminal, and you will see the Seasonal Themes option in the settings list, which appears only while the theme is in season. ⟦Much like a corner cafe temporarily putting up pumpkin decorations and limited-edition cup sleeves, the welcome sign and takeaway cups temporarily switch to festive designs.⟧ Turning on this feature displays a Halloween startup banner when the tool launches, changes the waiting spinner into a moon-phase animation, and adds a themed running light along with dedicated prompt box borders. title.zh-TW: 自動模式減少例行確認，無頭執行與介面反應更流暢
title.en: Auto Mode Reduces Routine Confirmations, Making Headless Execution and UI Response Smoother

body.zh-TW:
在讓 AI 自動處理專案或透過背景腳本批次執行時，你往往希望工具能安靜執行，不要頻繁被瑣碎中斷或耗盡電腦資源。

在 Auto 模式下，工具現在會減少針對例行指令的授權確認次數，包含清理暫存檔、結束本機行程，或是執行程式碼排版工具，都不會再頻繁跳出視窗要你逐一確認。

以 -p 參數執行無頭模式（沒有視覺介面的執行模式）時，處理器佔用顯著降低，在輸出長篇回覆或累積大量歷史紀錄時特別明顯。由於列印模式無需顯示畫面，因此不再建置搜尋索引與螢幕逐字稿，也不會再觸發自訂狀態列（終端機底部的即時資訊列）與視窗標題指令。

在日常互動介面中，無論是模型正在串流輸出文字、畫面跳出權限請求，或是手動縮放視窗大小，畫面更新速度都更快。以前跑背景批次常遇到處理器過載，現在資源消耗明顯降低，操作過程也少了不必要的打擾。
body.en:
When letting AI automatically handle projects or executing batch runs via background scripts, you often want the tool to run quietly without frequent interruptions or draining computer resources.

In Auto mode, the tool now asks for approval less often on routine commands; cleaning up temporary files, stopping local processes, or running code formatters will no longer frequently pop up windows asking for confirmation one by one.

When running in headless mode (an execution mode without a visual interface) with the -p flag, CPU usage is significantly reduced, which is especially noticeable when outputting long answers or accumulating many saved conversations. Because print mode does not need to display a visual interface, it no longer builds the search index or conversation transcripts for display, and it no longer starts custom status line (a real-time information bar at the bottom of the terminal) and window title commands.

In the everyday interactive interface, rendering speed is faster whether the model is streaming response text, a permission prompt appears, or you manually resize the window. While background batch runs previously ran into CPU overloads, resource consumption is now noticeably reduced, and the operating experience has fewer unnecessary interruptions.

items.original:
Improved Auto mode to ask for approval less often on routine commands, such as cleaning up temporary files, stopping a local process, or running a code formatter.
Improved headless `-p` runs to use much less CPU, especially for long answers and when you have many saved conversations: they no longer build the conversation search index or render the transcript for display, and no longer start your custom status line and window title commands, none of which print mode shows.
Improved rendering speed while a response streams, when a permission prompt appears, and when you resize the window.

title.zh-TW: 單一內容超出容量上限時，不再陷入反覆壓縮對話的迴圈
title.en: Conversations No Longer Loop Compacting When a Single Item Exceeds Context Capacity

body.zh-TW: 當你讓代理處理超大檔案或工具輸出巨量文字時，可能會遇到對話停滯。以前只要單一訊息、工具輸出或附加文件大到無法放進上下文（模型一次能讀取的對話範圍），對話就會陷入反覆壓縮的無限迴圈。這個問題現在已經修好，遇到超長內容時不會再卡在連續壓縮的狀態。
body.en: When you have the agent handle oversized files or tools output huge amounts of text, conversations could stall. Previously, whenever a single message, tool output, or attached document was too large to fit in the context (the conversation range a model can read at once), the conversation would fall into an infinite loop of repeated compaction. This issue has now been fixed, so encounters with extra-long content will no longer get stuck in continuous compaction.

items.original: Fixed conversations compacting over and over when a single message, tool output, or attached document was too large to fit in the context.

title.zh-TW: 外掛與 MCP 擴充功能修復憑證儲存，隨選工具回傳上限放寬至 10 KB
title.en: Plugins and MCP Extensions Fix Credential Storage, Relaxing On-Demand Tool Return Limit to 10 KB

body.zh-TW:
串接外部工具與外掛時，你可能遇過登入狀態沒存下來，或切換帳號後連線沒跟著換。

隨選載入的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具可直接向代理回傳最多 10 KB 結果；以前超過 4 KB 就得寫入檔案再額外讀取一次。

使用應用程式預設憑證（AGY_ADC_AUTH）登入時，技能、規則、自訂代理、外掛、外掛 MCP 伺服器與掛鉤無法載入的錯誤已修復。

在 macOS 與 Windows 上，外掛與 MCP 伺服器的權杖（授權令牌）過大、無法存入系統金鑰鏈時，會改存到本機私密檔案以保留登入狀態。

透過 OAuth 登入的外掛 MCP 伺服器權杖改為綁定登入者，修好了共用電腦帳號時誤用他人權杖的問題。先前切換帳號或登出後，仍可能保留前一位使用者的連線，這個問題也已修好。伺服器在切換帳號時會自動重連，可能需重新登入。
body.en:
When connecting external tools and plugins, you might have experienced login states failing to save or connections not updating after switching accounts.

MCP (a protocol allowing AI to connect to external tools) tools that are loaded on demand can now return results of up to 10 KB directly to the agent; previously, anything over 4 KB had to be written to a file and read again in an extra step.

When signing in with Application Default Credentials (AGY_ADC_AUTH), errors where skills, rules, custom agents, plugins, plugin MCP servers, and hooks failed to load have now been fixed.

On macOS and Windows, when a token (authorization credential) for plugins and MCP servers is too large to fit in the system keychain, it is now saved to a local private file to preserve the login state.

Tokens for plugin MCP servers signed in via OAuth are now bound to the signed-in user, fixing an issue where users sharing the same computer account could mistakenly use someone else's token. The previous issue where the prior user's connection might still be retained after switching accounts or signing out has also been fixed. These servers automatically reconnect when switching accounts, so you may need to sign in again.

items.original:
Improved MCP tools that are loaded on demand to return results of up to 10 KB directly to the agent; previously anything over 4 KB was saved to a file that the agent had to read in an extra step.
Fixed skills, rules, custom agents, plugins, plugin MCP servers, and hooks not loading when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`).
Fixed plugin and MCP server sign-ins not being saved on macOS and Windows when the token was too large for the system keychain; such tokens are now stored in the CLI's private secrets file.
Fixed plugin MCP servers that sign in with OAuth being able to use a token saved by another user of the same computer account, or keeping the previous user's connection after you switch accounts or sign out. Their tokens now belong to the signed-in user and these servers reconnect when the user changes, so you may need to sign in to them again.

title.zh-TW: 終端機排版與文字複製多項修復，說明清單精簡常用快速鍵
title.en: Terminal Formatting and Text Copying Receive Multiple Fixes, Streamlining Help Shortcuts

body.zh-TW:
在終端機內瀏覽輸出結果、複製程式碼或編輯文字時，細節排版直接左右閱讀與操作的流暢度。

輸入 /help 查看快速鍵分頁時，清單移除了方向鍵等基礎導覽鍵，方便你更快找到真正實用的進階快速鍵。

在表格呈現上，預設的 Terminal 配色改用框線繪製字元取代 ASCII 直線符號。儲存格內折行的長網址先前只有第一行附帶截斷的超連結，現在整段網址都能完整點擊與複製。

複製程式碼區塊或行內程式碼中折行的長指令時，貼上會合併為單行，不會在折行處夾帶多餘換行。程式碼區塊內的長行也會在單字之間折行，並保留區塊縮排。

在 Vim 模式的 Normal 與 Visual 模式下使用 r 替換文字時，先前會殘留部分摺疊的貼上標記，現在會乾淨取代整個預留位置。
body.en:
When browsing output, copying code, or editing text in the terminal, layout details directly dictate the smoothness of reading and operations.

When typing /help to view the shortcuts tab, the list removes basic navigation keys such as the arrow keys, making it easier to quickly find truly useful advanced shortcuts.

For table display, the default Terminal color scheme now uses box-drawing characters instead of ASCII vertical line symbols. Long links that wrap inside a cell were previously linked only on their first line to a truncated URL, but now the full URL can be clicked and copied.

When copying a long command that wraps across rows in a code block or inline code, pasting now merges it into a single line without extra line breaks at each wrap point. Long lines within code blocks also now break between words and retain the block indentation.

When using r to replace text in Vim mode's Normal and Visual modes, which previously left behind part of a collapsed paste marker, the entire placeholder is now cleanly replaced.

items.original:
Improved the `/help` shortcuts tab by leaving out basic navigation keys such as the arrow keys, so the more useful shortcuts are easier to find.
Fixed long links that wrap inside a Markdown table cell being linked only on their first line, to a truncated URL, so the whole link can now be clicked or copied. Tables in the default `Terminal` color scheme now use box-drawing borders instead of ASCII `|`, matching the other color schemes.
Fixed copying a long command that wraps across rows in a code block or inline code, which now copies as a single line instead of with a line break at each wrap point; wrapped code-block lines also now break between words and keep the block's indentation.
Fixed Vim mode's `r` replace, in Normal and Visual mode, leaving part of a collapsed `[Pasted text #N]` placeholder behind; the whole placeholder is now replaced.

entries: Added a `Configure MCP servers...` row for installed plugins in `/plugin`, so you can set or change a plugin's MCP server variables at any time without disabling and re-enabling it; plugins with missing values show `⚠ needs setup`, each server shows `✓ configured` or the variables it still needs, and saving restarts an enabled plugin's servers so the new values take effect.

Improved terminal sandbox defaults to protect more credentials: sandboxed commands can no longer read or modify `~/.docker`, `~/.kube`, or `~/_netrc` unless you grant access explicitly. Previously `~/.docker` and `~/.kube` were writable inside the sandbox, so sandboxed commands that use Docker registry or Kubernetes cluster credentials now need an explicit grant.
Improved context compaction, including `/compact`, to keep images, PDFs, and other files you attached in the conversation summary, so the agent can still see them after older history is summarized.

Improved permission prompts so that allowing an action for the conversation, in the main agent or in a subagent, applies across the main conversation and all of its subagents instead of asking again for the same action.

Improved the in-progress status line to show what the agent is waiting on, such as initializing MCP servers or retrying an unavailable model (for example `Model unavailable (attempt 2/10), retrying in 12s` with a live countdown), instead of a generic working label.
Improved `/diff` to highlight the exact words that changed within each modified line, in every color scheme.

Improved `agy plugin validate`: it now has `--help`, checks a plugin's context providers (missing `label` or `command`, invalid or duplicate triggers, unknown fields, missing command files), warns about `skills` entries in `plugin.json` that don't exist or contain no `SKILL.md`, and reports every `SKILL.md` the plugin loader skips, including skills listed through `plugin.json` or `skills.json`.
Fixed terminal commands occasionally failing to start with `argument list too long` when the model returned a very large reasoning signature with the tool call.

Fixed text cursors drifting away from the insertion point after wide characters (CJK, emoji), tabs, other Unicode spaces, and on soft-wrapped lines, including `Up`/`Down` landing on the wrong row, in the prompt and in the settings, permission amend, plugin setup, feedback, hooks, and artifact search boxes.
Fixed the `Esc disabled during file edits` warning naming the wrong reject key when the prompt shows an extra choice, such as for edits outside the workspace in accept-edits mode.
Fixed sign-in not persisting across restarts on macOS and Windows for enterprise accounts, because the saved credential exceeded the system keychain's size limit.

title.zh-TW: 外掛清單新增 MCP 伺服器設定列，不必停用再啟用即可改變數
title.en: Plugin List Adds MCP Server Configuration Row, Updating Variables Without Disabling and Re-enabling

body.zh-TW: 平時替終端機安裝各種外掛後，若想微調連線金鑰或伺服器參數，現在不必再先停用、再重新啟用外掛。輸入 `/plugin` 檢視已安裝的外掛清單，現在每一筆外掛底下都會出現 `Configure MCP servers...` 設定選項。⟦彷彿在舞台音響架旁微調效果器的獨立旋鈕，以前更換參數就得拔掉總電源重新開機；現在面板清楚標出哪些線路仍待調整，轉完旋鈕後新設定立刻接手生效。⟧若外掛還有未填寫的變數，清單會標示 `⚠ needs setup` 提醒補齊；每個伺服器也會標出狀態，已備妥的會顯示 `✓ configured`，尚未完成的則列出具體缺少的變數名稱。儲存後，已啟用的外掛會自動重啟對應的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，讓新數值立即生效。
body.en: When fine-tuning connection keys or server parameters after installing plugins in your terminal, there is no longer a need to disable and re-enable them. Entering `/plugin` to view the list of installed plugins now displays a `Configure MCP servers...` option beneath every entry. ⟦Picture tweaking an individual knob on a stage audio rack, where changing parameters once required pulling the main power plug to restart the entire system; now the panel clearly marks which lines still need adjustment, and after turning the knob, new settings take effect immediately.⟧ If a plugin still has empty variables, the list marks them with `⚠ needs setup` as a reminder to fill them in; each server shows `✓ configured` for ready ones and lists specific missing variable names for incomplete ones. After saving, enabled plugins automatically restart their corresponding MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) servers to apply new values immediately.

items.original: Added a `Configure MCP servers...` row for installed plugins in `/plugin`, so you can set or change a plugin's MCP server variables at any time without disabling and re-enabling it; plugins with missing values show `⚠ needs setup`, each server shows `✓ configured` or the variables it still needs, and saving restarts an enabled plugin's servers so the new values take effect.

title.zh-TW: 終端機沙盒預設保護更多憑證，存取 Docker 與 Kubernetes 需明確授權
title.en: Terminal Sandbox Protects More Credentials by Default, Requiring Explicit Authorization for Docker and Kubernetes Access

body.zh-TW: 在沙盒環境執行各類指令時，本機存放的敏感憑證現在有了更嚴格的預設隔離防護。沙盒指令預設不再允許讀取或修改 `~/.docker`、`~/.kube` 與 `~/_netrc` 這三處路徑，除非你明確授權放行。⟦跟入住出租套房的生活規範一樣，以前抽屜裡的私人證件預設敞開任人翻動；現在重要暗格直接上鎖，除非屋主親自授權放行，否則誰也不能隨意翻看。⟧過去沙盒內部預設開放寫入 `~/.docker` 與 `~/.kube`，因此現在任何需要使用 Docker registry（存放容器映像檔的倉庫）或 Kubernetes 叢集憑證的沙盒指令，都必須先取得你的明確授權才能繼續執行。
body.en: When running commands inside sandbox environments, locally stored sensitive credentials now receive stricter default isolation safeguards. Sandboxed commands no longer allow reading or modifying `~/.docker`, `~/.kube`, or `~/_netrc` by default unless you grant explicit authorization. ⟦Much like living rules in a rented studio, private documents inside drawers were previously left open for anyone to rummage through; now important compartments are locked directly, and no one may browse them without the owner's explicit permission.⟧ In the past, sandbox environments permitted writes to `~/.docker` and `~/.kube` by default. Consequently, any sandboxed command requiring Docker registry (a repository storing container images) credentials or Kubernetes cluster credentials must now obtain your explicit authorization before proceeding.

items.original: Improved terminal sandbox defaults to protect more credentials: sandboxed commands can no longer read or modify `~/.docker`, `~/.kube`, or `~/_netrc` unless you grant access explicitly. Previously `~/.docker` and `~/.kube` were writable inside the sandbox, so sandboxed commands that use Docker registry or Kubernetes cluster credentials now need an explicit grant.

title.zh-TW: 對話壓縮保留上傳圖片與 PDF，精簡歷史不漏看附件
title.en: Conversation Compaction Preserves Uploaded Images and PDFs, Keeping Attachments Accessible After History Pruning

body.zh-TW: 面對累積了大量訊息的長對話，手動或自動執行對話壓縮時，不用再擔心先前上傳的檔案就此消失。現在無論是系統自動觸發歷史壓縮，或是你在終端機手動輸入 `/compact`，對話摘要都會完整保留你先前上傳的圖片、PDF 與各類附件檔案。⟦翻閱裝訂成冊的案件卷宗，以前把過往紀錄濃縮成大綱時，夾在中間的現場照片與附件常被一併收進封存箱；現在所有參考文件都會直接釘在摘要首頁，回顧時隨時都能對照細節。⟧這讓 AI 即使在舊對話被精簡整合之後，依然能清楚讀取這些附加檔案，繼續針對檔案內的細節回答問題。
body.en: When facing long conversations with accumulated messages, you no longer need to worry about previously uploaded files disappearing during manual or automatic conversation compaction. Whether the system automatically triggers history compaction or you manually enter `/compact` in the terminal, the conversation summary completely preserves your previously uploaded images, PDFs, and various attachment files. ⟦Leafing through a bound case file where past records were condensed into outlines, crime scene photos and attachments clipped inside once got tucked away into storage boxes; now all reference documents remain pinned directly to the front page of the summary, ready for checking details at any review.⟧ This ensures the AI can still clearly inspect these attached files and continue answering questions regarding details within them, even after older exchanges are condensed and consolidated.

items.original: Improved context compaction, including `/compact`, to keep images, PDFs, and other files you attached in the conversation summary, so the agent can still see them after older history is summarized.

title.zh-TW: 授權範圍涵蓋主對話與子代理，同項操作不必重複確認
title.en: Authorization Scope Extends Across Main Conversation and Subagents, Eliminating Repeated Confirmations for the Same Operation

body.zh-TW: 把複雜任務交給子代理（在背景協助分工的獨立 AI 助理）分頭處理時，頻繁跳出的授權確認常打斷工作節奏。現在選擇針對整個對話允許這項操作後，無論你是在主對話還是子代理的授權提示中做出選擇，這項權限都會直接套用到整個主對話與旗下所有子代理。⟦持同一張專案通行證進出實驗大樓，以前只要換了不同助理人員進場操作，門禁警衛就得把主管叫出來重新簽核；現在只要主專案獲准通行，旗下所有支援團隊都能共用這項授權直接開工。⟧這省去了子代理遇到相同操作時再次請你確認的麻煩，分工作業不再頻繁中斷。
body.en: When delegating complex tasks to subagents (independent AI assistants helping divide work in the background), frequent authorization prompts often interrupt your workflow. Now, after choosing to allow an operation for the entire conversation, that permission applies directly across the entire main conversation and all of its subagents, regardless of whether you approved it from the main thread or a subagent's prompt. ⟦Holding a single project pass to access a research facility, bringing in a new assistant previously required security guards to call a manager for fresh sign-offs; now once the main project clears access, all supporting teams share that authorization to begin work immediately.⟧ This saves you from repeated approval prompts when subagents perform the same operation, keeping distributed work uninterrupted.

items.original: Improved permission prompts so that allowing an action for the conversation, in the main agent or in a subagent, applies across the main conversation and all of its subagents instead of asking again for the same action.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列顯示具體等待進度，模型重試附帶動態倒數
title.en: Status Line Displays Specific Waiting Progress with Dynamic Countdown for Model Retries

body.zh-TW: 送出複雜任務等待回應時，終端機不再只丟給你一個模糊的處理中標籤。終端機底部的 status line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）現在會具體列出 AI 當下正在等待的環節，取代過去籠統的運作標籤。例如它正在初始化 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，或是遇到模型暫時無法使用而自動重試時，都能即時掌握當前狀態。遇到重試狀況時，狀態列會直接出現類似 `Model unavailable (attempt 2/10), retrying in 12s` 的動態倒數秒數與嘗試次數。⟦看著候機室的電子告示牌，以前遇到班機延誤只顯示含糊的處理中，讓人只能盯著螢幕乾等；現在看板會即時標明正在調度登機門，並附上精確的倒數時間。⟧
body.en: When submitting complex tasks and waiting for responses, the terminal no longer leaves you with a vague in-progress label. The status line (the status bar displayed at the very bottom of the terminal) now specifically lists the exact step the AI is waiting on, replacing previous generic activity indicators. Whether it is initializing an MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) server or automatically retrying when a model is temporarily unavailable, you can monitor current status in real time. During retry scenarios, the status line directly shows a dynamic countdown in seconds alongside the attempt count, such as `Model unavailable (attempt 2/10), retrying in 12s`. ⟦Flight display boards in an airport departure lounge once showed only a vague processing notice during flight delays, leaving passengers to stare helplessly at screens; now the board clearly states that a gate is being scheduled alongside an exact countdown.⟧

items.original: Improved the in-progress status line to show what the agent is waiting on, such as initializing MCP servers or retrying an unavailable model (for example `Model unavailable (attempt 2/10), retrying in 12s` with a live countdown), instead of a generic working label.

title.zh-TW: `/diff` 逐字突顯行內修改差異，各配色主題皆能清楚辨識
title.en: `/diff` Highlights Word-Level Inline Changes with Clear Visibility Across All Color Themes

body.zh-TW: 想看清程式碼或文字修改前後究竟動了哪幾個字，比對畫面現在能精準指出變更核心。只要在終端機輸入 `/diff` 查看修改差異，在所有色彩配置主題下，畫面都會直接在變動的那一行當中，標出真正發生變更的字詞。⟦拿螢光筆校對合約草稿時，圈出實際替換的字詞，就能把目光集中到修改的位置；現在的比對畫面也會替你標出這些重點，讓你查看每個修改行內究竟換了哪些字詞。⟧
body.en: When you want to see exactly which words were altered before and after code or text modifications, the diff view now pinpoints the core of every change with precision. Simply entering `/diff` in the terminal to inspect modifications highlights the exact words that changed right within the modified line across all color themes. ⟦Using a highlighter to proofread contract drafts, circling replaced words once helped focus attention on actual modifications; now the diff view flags those focal points for you so you can inspect exactly which words were swapped within each modified line.⟧

items.original: Improved `/diff` to highlight the exact words that changed within each modified line, in every color scheme.

title.zh-TW: 外掛驗證支援說明選單，全面檢驗設定結構與技能檔
title.en: Plugin Validation Adds Help Flag, Thoroughly Verifying Config Structures and Skill Files

body.zh-TW:
開發自訂外掛時若想排查設定檔結構是否合法，現在有了更詳盡的驗證工具。在終端機執行外掛驗證指令，現在支援 `--help` 查看說明參數，並針對各項設定進行完整檢驗：

```bash
agy plugin validate --help
```

它會檢查情境提供者（context providers）的設定細節，抓出缺少 `label` 或 `command`、觸發字詞無效或重複、未知欄位，以及執行指令檔遺失等問題。針對技能設定，若 `plugin.json` 裡宣告的 `skills` 項目不存在或缺少 `SKILL.md`，驗證工具會主動發出警告，並詳細回報載入器跳過的所有 `SKILL.md`，包含透過 `plugin.json` 或 `skills.json` 引入的技能檔案。⟦檢查即將出廠的組裝模型盒，以前只粗略核對外盒印製的零件總數；現在檢驗員逐一對照說明書，抓出缺漏的組裝步驟與對不上的零件，連跳過未裝的模組都詳細列出。⟧
body.en:
When troubleshooting configuration file structures while developing custom plugins, more detailed validation tooling is now available. Running the plugin validation command in the terminal now supports `--help` to inspect parameter documentation and performs comprehensive verification across settings:

```bash
agy plugin validate --help
```

It inspects configuration details for context providers, catching missing `label` or `command` entries, invalid or duplicate trigger words, unknown fields, and missing executable script files. For skill configuration, if a `skills` entry declared in `plugin.json` does not exist or lacks `SKILL.md`, the validation tool issues a warning and reports in detail all `SKILL.md` files skipped by the loader, including skill files brought in via `plugin.json` or `skills.json`. ⟦A factory inspector examining a boxed model kit once only checked the total part count printed on the packaging; now the inspector cross-checks the instruction manual step by step to catch missing assembly steps and mismatched components, listing even the unmounted modules that were skipped.⟧

items.original: Improved `agy plugin validate`: it now has `--help`, checks a plugin's context providers (missing `label` or `command`, invalid or duplicate triggers, unknown fields, missing command files), warns about `skills` entries in `plugin.json` that don't exist or contain no `SKILL.md`, and reports every `SKILL.md` the plugin loader skips, including skills listed through `plugin.json` or `skills.json`.

title.zh-TW: 終端機游標修正全形字與換行偏誤，上下方向鍵精準對位
title.en: Terminal Cursor Resolves Offsets for Full-Width Characters and Line Wraps, Aligning Up and Down Arrow Keys Accurately

body.zh-TW: 打字輸入中文、日文、韓文或表情符號時，終端機游標現在能精準停在插入點。以前在指令提示列，以及設定、權限修改、外掛設定、意見回饋、掛鉤與成品搜尋框中，輸入中日韓全形字（CJK）、表情符號、定位字元、特殊空白或文字遇到自動換行時，游標常會偏離插入點，按上下方向鍵也會跳到錯誤的行數。這個問題已經修好，游標與方向鍵現在都能正確停在對應文字位置。
body.en: When typing Chinese, Japanese, Korean, or emoji, the terminal cursor now stays accurately positioned at the insertion point. Previously, entering full-width CJK (Chinese, Japanese, and Korean) characters, emoji, tab characters, special whitespace, or wrapped text in the command prompt, as well as in the settings, permission amendment, plugin setup, feedback, hooks, or artifact search boxes, often caused the cursor to drift from the insertion point and made up and down arrow keys jump to the wrong line. This issue has been resolved, and both the cursor and arrow keys now land on the correct text positions.

items.original: Fixed text cursors drifting away from the insertion point after wide characters (CJK, emoji), tabs, other Unicode spaces, and on soft-wrapped lines, including `Up`/`Down` landing on the wrong row, in the prompt and in the settings, permission amend, plugin setup, feedback, hooks, and artifact search boxes.

title.zh-TW: 指令啟動、檔案編輯提示與企業登入的三項異常修復
title.en: Three Fixes for Command Execution, File Edit Prompts, and Enterprise Login Issues

body.zh-TW:
平時呼叫工具跑指令、想退回工作區外的變更，或是重新啟動後準備上工時，你可能曾碰過莫名報錯或被迫重新登入。

工具呼叫附帶很大的 reasoning signature（推論簽章，模型隨工具呼叫回傳的資料）時，指令以前偶爾無法啟動並回報 `argument list too long`；這個問題已修好。

提示畫面多出一個選項時，例如在接受編輯模式（accept-edits mode）下修改工作區外的檔案，警告標語 `Esc disabled during file edits` 先前會寫錯拒絕鍵的名稱，現在會寫出正確的拒絕鍵。

macOS 與 Windows 上的企業帳號先前若因登入憑證超出系統鑰匙圈的大小上限，重新啟動後登入狀態便會失效；這個問題已經修好，登入狀態現在能在重新啟動後正常延續。
body.en:
When calling tools to execute commands, reverting changes outside your workspace, or preparing to work after a restart, you might have occasionally encountered unexpected errors or forced re-logins.

When tool calls included a large reasoning signature (data returned by models alongside tool calls), commands occasionally failed to launch with `argument list too long`; this issue has been resolved.

When the prompt shows an extra choice, such as for edits outside the workspace in accept-edits mode, the warning banner `Esc disabled during file edits` previously named the wrong reject key; it now names the correct one.

When enterprise accounts on macOS and Windows had login credentials exceeding the system keychain size limit, their login state was previously lost upon restarting; this issue has been resolved, and login status now persists properly across restarts.

items.original:
Fixed terminal commands occasionally failing to start with `argument list too long` when the model returned a very large reasoning signature with the tool call.
Fixed the `Esc disabled during file edits` warning naming the wrong reject key when the prompt shows an extra choice, such as for edits outside the workspace in accept-edits mode.
Fixed sign-in not persisting across restarts on macOS and Windows for enterprise accounts, because the saved credential exceeded the system keychain's size limit.

entries: Improved how agent responses read: a blank line now separates the collapsed thought block from the response, and once the response starts, the collapsed thought shows only its `Thought for …` header instead of repeating a snippet of the thinking; expand it to see the full thinking.

Improved `/` search in the `/diff` file view to count matches inside folded unchanged lines, such as `match 2/5 · +3 hidden` or `no matches · +1 hidden`, and the `f` hint now reads `show N hidden matches`.

Improved `/diff`'s `Commit Tree` to mark the selected commit with the same `>` cursor and selection color as `All Changes` and `Per Turn` instead of a highlighted bar, and made `Per Turn` start with the cursor on the first file instead of its turn header.

Improved recurring cron schedules created with the agent's `schedule` tool to fire at a consistent per-schedule offset instead of exactly on the cron boundary, to avoid traffic spikes: schedules that repeat within a day, such as every 30 minutes or hourly, now fire somewhere within their period, fixed-time schedules such as daily at 9:00 still fire within their scheduled minute, and the agent can request exact timing when a schedule needs it. `@every` schedules are unchanged.
Improved idle CPU usage by pausing screen refreshes while nothing on screen changes, roughly halving the CLI's CPU use when it is idle.
Improved CPU usage while a response streams by skipping redundant screen updates and refreshing the credit balance less often.
Improved rendering speed for long conversations, and made long conversations load faster when you resume them.
Improved startup CPU usage when the CLI refreshes its conversation summaries.
Improved memory usage by allocating storage for the prompt and other text inputs as you type instead of reserving it up front.
Fixed the agent silently retrying, potentially without end, when a model response was blocked by content safety filters.
Fixed plugins failing to load when `plugin.json` gives `skills` as a single path string, such as `"skills": "./skills/"`, instead of an array, as some plugins written for other tools do.
Fixed marketplace plugin installs and automatic updates failing with a checksum mismatch or network error when a download was briefly stale or interrupted; the CLI now retries the download once.

title.zh-TW: 回覆正文與收合思考區塊空行區隔，頂端僅保留標題
title.en: Blank line separates response text from collapsed thought block, leaving only the header at the top

body.zh-TW: 閱讀代理人剛生成的回覆時，若思考過程與正文擠成一團，往往會打斷閱讀節奏。⟦像在會議中翻閱專案報告，以前草稿筆記直接黏在結論上方容易分散焦點；現在頂端只留一張寫著構思時間的簡潔書籤，中間隔出一行空白，正文一目了然，需要時再翻開整份草稿。⟧現在代理人開始輸出回覆後，收合的思考區塊只會顯示 `Thought for …` 標題，不再重複列出思考過程的文字片段。收合的思考區塊與正文之間也多了一行空行隔開，文字段落不會再擠在一起。如果你想確認剛才完整的推導邏輯，只要手動展開該區塊，依然能查閱完整的思考內容。
body.en: When reading a newly generated response from an agent, having the thought process clustered against the main text often breaks your reading flow. ⟦Picture reviewing a project report during a meeting: previously, draft notes stuck directly above the conclusion would distract focus, whereas now only a neat bookmark noting thinking time remains at the top with a blank line in between, keeping the main text clear at a glance while letting you unfold the full draft whenever needed.⟧ Now, once the agent begins outputting a response, the collapsed thought block only displays the `Thought for …` header instead of repeating text snippets from the thought process. A blank line also separates the collapsed thought block from the main text, so text paragraphs no longer bunch together. If you want to verify the complete reasoning logic behind it, you can still view the full thoughts simply by expanding the block manually.

items.original: Improved how agent responses read: a blank line now separates the collapsed thought block from the response, and once the response starts, the collapsed thought shows only its `Thought for …` header instead of repeating a snippet of the thinking; expand it to see the full thinking.

title.zh-TW: 比對檢視支援折疊搜尋計數，游標樣式與停駐位置對齊
title.en: Diff view supports folded search counts, aligning cursor style and resting position

body.zh-TW: 檢閱程式碼變更時，折疊起來的未更動行數常讓搜尋結果變得難以掌握。⟦好比翻閱厚重的帳冊索引，以前夾在折頁裡的項目算不進筆數，各分冊的標記色塊也不一致；現在標籤直接註記折疊處藏有幾筆帳目，選取欄位也統一換成箭頭符號，翻到當前回合就直接對準第一筆明細。⟧在 `/diff` 檔案檢視中以 `/` 搜尋時，工具現在會計算折疊行內的相符項目，以 `match 2/5 · +3 hidden` 顯示隱藏數量，`f` 鍵展開提示也改為 `show N hidden matches`。介面上，`Commit Tree` 改用與 `All Changes` 及 `Per Turn` 相同的 `>` 游標與選取色，不再用高亮色塊；切換到 `Per Turn` 時游標也會直接停在第一個檔案，不必再跳過回合標題。
body.en: When reviewing code changes, collapsed unchanged lines often make search results hard to track. ⟦Much like browsing a thick ledger index, items tucked inside folded pages were previously excluded from match counts and marker color blocks across volumes were inconsistent, whereas tabs now directly annotate how many entries are hidden in folds, selection columns uniformly switch to arrow symbols, and turning to the current turn lands straight on the first detail.⟧ When searching with `/` inside the `/diff` file view, the tool now counts matches within folded lines, displaying the hidden count as `match 2/5 · +3 hidden`, and the `f` key expand hint is now updated to `show N hidden matches`. On the interface, `Commit Tree` now uses the same `>` cursor and selection color as `All Changes` and `Per Turn` instead of highlight blocks; when switching to `Per Turn`, the cursor also rests directly on the first file without needing to skip past turn headers.

items.original:
Improved `/` search in the `/diff` file view to count matches inside folded unchanged lines, such as `match 2/5 · +3 hidden` or `no matches · +1 hidden`, and the `f` hint now reads `show N hidden matches`.
Improved `/diff`'s `Commit Tree` to mark the selected commit with the same `>` cursor and selection color as `All Changes` and `Per Turn` instead of a highlighted bar, and made `Per Turn` start with the cursor on the first file instead of its turn header.

title.zh-TW: 循環排程引入偏移時間差，避免整點邊界流量暴增
title.en: Recurring schedules introduce time offsets to prevent traffic spikes on hour boundaries

body.zh-TW: 若有多個背景任務排在整點同時啟動，瞬間湧入的連線很容易讓伺服器塞車。⟦跟社區大樓安排住戶分流一樣，以前所有單位全擠在整點出門容易在閘門大塞車；現在為每個單位分配固定的前後時間差，整點前後平順出發，需要分秒不差的專車依然能申請在準點出發。⟧由代理人透過 `schedule` 工具建立的循環 cron 排程，現在觸發時會依每個排程套用固定的偏移時間，不再剛好卡在整點邊界，有效分散尖峰流量。在一天內多次重複的任務（例如每 30 分鐘或每小時一次），會在各自週期內的特定時間點觸發。每天早上 9:00 等固定時間排程，依然會在預定的該分鐘內執行。若排程需要嚴格對準時刻，代理人也能要求精確時間，而 `@every` 間隔排程則維持原樣不變。
body.en: When multiple background tasks are scheduled to launch at the same time on the hour, an instant surge of connections easily congests the server. ⟦Just as a residential complex staggers departures for its tenants, having every household head out right on the hour previously caused massive gate congestion, but assigning a fixed offset window to each unit now smooths out traffic around the hour while reserved shuttles that require exact timing can still request sharp departure times.⟧ Recurring cron schedules created by an agent via the `schedule` tool now apply a fixed offset time to each schedule when triggered, no longer landing exactly on hour boundaries and effectively spreading out peak traffic. Tasks that repeat multiple times throughout the day (such as every 30 minutes or once an hour) trigger at specific points within their respective intervals. Fixed-time schedules like 9:00 AM every morning still execute within their scheduled minute. If a schedule requires strict time alignment, the agent can also request exact timing, while `@every` interval schedules remain unchanged.

items.original: Improved recurring cron schedules created with the agent's `schedule` tool to fire at a consistent per-schedule offset instead of exactly on the cron boundary, to avoid traffic spikes: schedules that repeat within a day, such as every 30 minutes or hourly, now fire somewhere within their period, fixed-time schedules such as daily at 9:00 still fire within their scheduled minute, and the agent can request exact timing when a schedule needs it. `@every` schedules are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: 降低閒置與執行資源消耗，長對話與啟動載入更流暢
title.en: Reduced idle and runtime resource consumption with smoother long conversations and startup loading

body.zh-TW:
長時間在終端機開啟工具或處理大型專案時，背景消耗的硬體資源現在明顯下降。

當畫面沒有任何文字變動時，終端機會暫停螢幕重繪，讓閒置時的 CPU 使用率約減少一半。而在模型輸出串流回覆的過程中，工具會略過重複的畫面更新，並降低額度餘額的刷新頻率以節省運算效能。

長篇對話的渲染效能有所改善，重新恢復長對話工作階段時的載入速度也提升。命令列介面啟動並刷新對話摘要時，CPU 開銷也一併降低。

在記憶體管理方面，輸入提示詞與各類文字時改為打字時才動態配置儲存空間，不再預先保留整塊記憶體。閒置時的 CPU 消耗降低，長對話顯示與恢復載入也更快。
body.en:
When keeping the tool open in the terminal for long periods or working on large projects, background hardware resource consumption has now noticeably decreased.

When there are no text changes on screen, the terminal pauses screen repaints, cutting idle CPU usage roughly in half. Meanwhile, while the model streams output, the tool skips redundant screen redraws and lowers the refresh frequency of quota balances to save computing power.

Rendering performance for long conversations has improved, and loading speed when resuming long conversation sessions has also increased. When the command-line interface launches and refreshes conversation summaries, CPU overhead is similarly reduced.

Regarding memory management, storage space for prompt inputs and various texts is now dynamically allocated during typing instead of pre-allocating entire memory blocks. Idle CPU consumption drops, and long conversation display as well as resumption loading become faster.

items.original:
Improved idle CPU usage by pausing screen refreshes while nothing on screen changes, roughly halving the CLI's CPU use when it is idle.
Improved CPU usage while a response streams by skipping redundant screen updates and refreshing the credit balance less often.
Improved rendering speed for long conversations, and made long conversations load faster when you resume them.
Improved startup CPU usage when the CLI refreshes its conversation summaries.
Improved memory usage by allocating storage for the prompt and other text inputs as you type instead of reserving it up front.

title.zh-TW: 模型遭安全機制阻擋時停止無止盡重試
title.en: Stop infinite retries when the model is blocked by safety mechanisms

body.zh-TW: 遇上模型回覆被內容安全過濾機制阻擋的突發狀況，代理人過去容易陷入停不下來的重試迴圈。以前遇到回應被安全過濾器阻擋時，代理人會在背景靜默重試，甚至可能陷入無止盡的重試迴圈；現在這個問題已經修好，遇到阻擋時不再默默持續重試。
body.en: When encountering unexpected situations where a model response was blocked by content safety filters, agents previously tended to get trapped in an endless retry loop. In the past, when a response was blocked by safety filters, the agent would silently retry in the background and could even enter an infinite retry loop; this issue has now been resolved, and it no longer keeps silently retrying when blocked.

items.original: Fixed the agent silently retrying, potentially without end, when a model response was blocked by content safety filters.

title.zh-TW: 外掛設定支援以字串指定技能路徑，避免載入失敗
title.en: Plugin configuration supports specifying skill paths as strings to prevent loading failures

body.zh-TW: 想載入為其他工具設計的外掛程式時，設定檔格式只要稍有不同就會直接報錯。以前如果外掛的 `plugin.json` 將 `skills` 欄位寫成單一路徑字串（例如 `"skills": "./skills/"`）而非陣列清單，外掛就會載入失敗。現在這個問題已經修好，工具能正確辨識單一路徑字串並完成載入。
body.en: When trying to load plugins designed for other tools, any slight difference in configuration format would directly trigger an error. Previously, if a plugin's `plugin.json` specified the `skills` field as a single path string (such as `"skills": "./skills/"`) instead of an array list, the plugin failed to load. This issue has now been resolved, and the tool correctly recognizes a single path string and completes loading.

items.original: Fixed plugins failing to load when `plugin.json` gives `skills` as a single path string, such as `"skills": "./skills/"`, instead of an array, as some plugins written for other tools do.

title.zh-TW: 市集外掛安裝與更新遇網路中斷自動重試一次
title.en: Marketplace plugin installation and updates automatically retry once on network interruption

body.zh-TW: 從市集安裝或自動更新外掛程式時，偶發的網路震盪容易造成程序中斷。以前下載內容短暫過時或下載中斷時，市集外掛安裝與自動更新可能因校驗碼不符或網路錯誤而失敗；現在命令列介面會自動重試下載一次。
